entities.summary: The house-museum and memorial complex of Huseyn Javid is a memorial museum dedicated to the Azerbaijani poet and playwright, Huseyn Javid. It is located near Mausoleum of Huseyn Javid in the capital of Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, the city of Nakhchivan.
